pois.name: Taman Suropati
pois.description: Menteng's iconic central park — a century-old botanical garden surrounded by grand Art Deco and Dutch colonial residences. International bronze sculptures donated by ASEAN nations dot the lush grounds.

pois.name: Tugu Proklamasi
pois.description: Indonesia's Proclamation Monument, marking the site where Sukarno and Hatta proclaimed Indonesian independence on 17 August 1945. The original house was demolished; the 17m obelisk and bronze busts stand in its place.

pois.name: Museum Kebangkitan Nasional
pois.description: National Awakening Museum in the former STOVIA Dutch medical school (1902) — the birthplace of Budi Utomo, Indonesia's first nationalist organisation. The building's Javanese pavilion courtyard is exceptional.

pois.name: Taman Menteng
pois.description: A large public park in the heart of Menteng, built on the former Persija Jakarta football stadium. A relaxed escape from the city with food carts, cycling paths, and families gathering in the evening.

pois.name: Jalan Diponegoro
pois.description: Menteng's most prestigious boulevard, lined with grand Dutch-era colonial villas now housing embassies, consulates, and ministerial residences. The tree-canopied street is one of Jakarta's finest urban promenades.
